_comment: Canonical entry-intent preset catalog (UX-DESIGN Flow A; I4 = claude-tools-vvh). Single source of truth for both the Intake UI (web/intake/) AND the enricher hat (agents/enricher.system.md). Adding a NORMAL preset is one PR: append a row here, mirror it in web/functions/api/intake/_presets-catalog.js (keep in lockstep), add the prompt-resolution bullet in enricher.system.md, add the value:gate row to PRESET_ENUM in gate-policy.sh. See intake-presets.md for the playbook. Order in `presets` is the UI radio order; the first entry is the default selection. SPECIAL presets (`routing` set, e.g. `overview-request`/L4/claude-tools-uxvl4) BREAK the reductive (entry_stage, gate_aggressiveness) contract on purpose: they produce NO bd task and route on the daemon dispatch side. They carry `entry_stage:null` + `gate_aggressiveness:null` + a `routing` discriminator, are exempt from the L1/L2 spine checks in test-intake-presets.sh, and MUST be branched on by name in daemon/intake-dispatch-poll.sh (the harness enforces that lockstep). schema_version 2 added the optional `routing` field.

presets.label: Send it down the pipeline
presets.description: Default. No human gate on pickup; the runner picks the bead up at stage:impl and only surfaces if a worker hits a real fork (STUCK_NEEDS_HUMAN).

presets.label: Go over the UI with me
presets.sublabel: I want to collaborate at the stage where it lands.
presets.description: Bead lands at stage:ux and is routed to the Inbox as "ready to pair" — the runner does NOT auto-pick-up. The human asked to be IN the stage, not just approve its output.

presets.label: Just catch me up
presets.description: Special (claude-tools-uxvl4 / L4): creates NO bd task. The daemon's intake-dispatch-poll branches on this value and routes it to a dossier-builder that publishes a proactive_checkpoint timed-fyi (a Blueprint refresh / FYI) to the Inbox — it never enters the enricher or the L1 stage / L2 gate spine. The idea_text is the framing of what to brief on.
